exposure.needed: which monitoring systems or alerting rules actively reference the old metric name lbipam_ips_available_total at runtime

consequence.statement: Monitoring queries, dashboards, or alerting rules that reference the metric name lbipam_ips_available_total will no longer receive data and will stop functioning.
consequence.remediation: Update all monitoring systems, Prometheus queries, dashboards, and alert rules to use the new metric name lbipam_ips_available instead of lbipam_ips_available_total.

assertion.statement: The metric lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior renamed
